verdicts.why: Seed has 'do you want to climb'; 'do want to go' has 'you' interposed and 'go' for 'climb', so no single value is forced.
'near' glosses ළඟ, a word of its own LEGO 'ඉහළ ළඟ => the top'; the seed renders it as 'top', not 'near'.
'to be' glosses ඉන්නේ in LEGO 'to appear angry'; the seed says 'appear angry' and has no 'to be'.
'to do' glosses කරන්නයි, which is part of LEGO 'to discuss' in the seed 'to discuss'; the seed has no 'do'.
Seed has 'I knew', the row has present 'I know'; the tense differs.
'to make' is a synonym gloss of හදන්නයි; the seed says 'create' and the LEGO says 'trying to create'.
Seed has 'Could', the row has 'can'; this is the present form of the modal.
Seed has 'sounds as though', the row has 'sounds like'; the phrase differs and 'that' is not part of it.
'although ... did' glosses the particle කළාට; the seed ('better than I was last time') does not render it.
'to go' glosses යන්නට, but the seed and the LEGO say 'travel'.
Seed has the contraction "I'm sure"; 'am sure' is the uncontracted form, and the correct value is not forced.
The row matches its LEGO 'the big wide world', but the seed says 'a big world'.
Row says 'didn't want to' while the seed says 'didn't need to'; the LEGO has 'need', so the LEGO and seed agree and the row is the odd one.
'that' glosses the particle කියලා; the seed 'I didn't think she was right' has no 'that'.
'can't go' against seed "couldn't reach"; the modal tense and the verb differ.
Row says 'always stands alone', the seed and LEGO say "standing alone", and 'always' and the verb form are not in the seed.
Seed has plural 'holidays', the row has 'a holiday'.
'very' glosses ගොඩ, but the seed renders it as 'more' ('more patient').
Seed has 'could', the row has 'can'; the modal tense differs.
Row says 'need' while the seed says 'We want to become'; the LEGO says 'we want'.
